reason: A terminal-based client for orchestrating DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions, commands, tools, approvals, and subagents through a Claude Code-style interface.

summaries.zh: 通过类似 Claude Code 的终端界面编排 DeepSeek Harness 智能体、会话、命令、工具、审批和子智能体。
summaries.en: A Claude Code-style terminal client for orchestrating DeepSeek Harness agents, sessions, commands, tools, approvals, and subagents.

capabilities: Provides a terminal user interface for interacting with DeepSeek Harness models and agents
Manages durable sessions, session resumption, approvals, questions, and foreground or background subagents
Invokes configured Harness commands and tools through the runtime
Accepts provider credentials and model selections through the interface
Supports bounded file mentions in prompts
